operator_text.quote: Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics of Siberian Branch Russian Academy of Sciences (BINP SB RAS)
operator_text.value: Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences (BINP SB RAS)

summary.plain: Russia's largest academic physics institute, in Akademgorodok near Novosibirsk, Siberia. It has operated electron-positron colliders for over half a century; today VEPP-2000 and VEPP-4M and their detectors CMD-3, SND and KEDR measure how particles are made at low and medium energies.
summary.technical: BINP SB RAS, established May 1958 on the basis of the Laboratory of New Methods of Acceleration led by G. I. Budker; operates the VEPP-2000 and VEPP-4M e⁺e⁻ colliders (CMD-3, SND; KEDR), synchrotron-radiation sources and free-electron lasers.
